About Us

The Nirmaan Philosophy

Creating Leaders,
Shaping Futures.

Nirmaan (निर्माण) means creation. We believe in building a platform where young diplomats can express their ideas, debate pressing global issues, and architect solutions for a better tomorrow.

Rooted in cultural elegance and academic rigor, Nirmaan MUN is not just a simulation; it's an experience designed to foster critical thinking, negotiation, and leadership.

MUN Glossary

Moderated Caucus

A form of debate where delegates are called upon by the Chair to speak for a set amount of time on a specific sub-topic.

Unmoderated Caucus

Informal debate time where delegates can freely move around the room to discuss and draft resolutions.

Working Paper

A rough draft of ideas and solutions compiled by a group of delegates before forming a formal Draft Resolution.
